premises.text: Web publishing is a broken experience for the majority of people
premises.evidence_span: There's a part of the Internet that's fundamentally broken, and I'm not talking about Wi-Fi. It's the experience of creating something, putting it online, and sharing it with the world.

premises.text: The majority of people lack the technical skills to make changes to web pages
premises.evidence_span: the people that know how to do this, all the HTML, CSS, they're less than 1% of the population.

premises.text: PageCloud allows users to edit web pages easily without needing technical skills
premises.evidence_span: In a PageCloud world, everyone with a web browser gets complete creative freedom.

premises.text: PageCloud enables immediate publishing of changes made to web pages
premises.evidence_span: When we hit Save to look at our changes, they are immediately live on the web.

premises.text: PageCloud simplifies making web pages mobile-friendly
premises.evidence_span: PageCloud dramatically simplifies the incredibly complex task of making web pages mobile-friendly.

premises.text: PageCloud allows users to copy and edit existing web pages accurately
premises.evidence_span: PageCloud will analyze everything that's going on on this page, break it down into its root content, and rebuild it in PageCloud editable format.

premises.text: PageCloud offers unique features that are not available on other platforms

value.text: Users gain creative control over web publishing without technical barriers

notes: No external knowledge or traction metrics included.
